yaml:
name: Detect Changes

on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      code_changed:
        description: 'Whether code or tests changed'
        value: ${{ jobs.detect-changes.outputs.code_changed }}
      tests_changed:
        description: 'Whether tests changed'
        value: ${{ jobs.detect-changes.outputs.tests_changed }}
      deps_changed:
        description: 'Whether dependency files changed'
        value: ${{ jobs.detect-changes.outputs.deps_changed }}
      content_changed:
        description: 'Whether content files changed'
        value: ${{ jobs.detect-changes.outputs.content_changed }}
      seo_changed:
        description: 'Whether SEO files changed'
        value: ${{ jobs.detect-changes.outputs.seo_changed }}
      secret_scan_needed:
        description: 'Whether secret scanning should run'
        value: ${{ jobs.detect-changes.outputs.secret_scan_needed }}

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      code_changed: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.code == 'true' || steps.filter.outputs.tests == 'true' }}
      tests_changed: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.tests }}
      deps_changed: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.deps }}
      content_changed: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.content }}
      seo_changed: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.seo }}
      secret_scan_needed: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || steps.filter.outputs.code == 'true' || steps.filter.outputs.deps == 'true' }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Detect changed files
        id: filter
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        with:
          filters: |
            code:
              - 'src/**/*.ts'
              - 'src/**/*.tsx'
              - 'lib/**/*.ts'
              - 'lib/**/*.tsx'
              - 'scripts/**/*.ts'
              - 'scripts/**/*.tsx'
            tests:
              - '**/*.test.ts'
              - '**/*.spec.ts'
              - '__tests__/**/*.ts'
              - 'tests/**/*.ts'
            deps:
              - 'package.json'
              - 'package-lock.json'
              - 'yarn.lock'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'tsconfig.json'
            content:
              - 'content/**/*.md'
              - 'content/**/*.json'
              - 'public/**/*.html'
              - 'public/**/*.md'
              - 'public/**/*.json'
            seo:
              - 'public/**/*.html'
